desk: Pitch — Bramble Ridge Outdoor rebrand and launch
title: Identity route A, moodboard
prompt: Overhead flat-lay of a brand identity moodboard on a sheet of rough chalk-white watercolour paper: plain unprinted colour swatch cards in deep forest green, warm ochre and granite grey, a square of waxed canvas, a coil of worn boot lace, a pressed eucalyptus leaf, a small brass carabiner, a graphite pencil, and a torn scrap of paper printed with an abstract topographic contour-line pattern that has no labels or numbers. Soft diffused daylight from one side, gentle natural shadows, editorial still-life styling, calm earthy palette, generous space between objects.
promptSuffix: No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks. If people appear they are anonymous and not looking at the camera.
